name: OpenStreetMap
reason: Every hike, Trailhead, amenity and the TrailGraph; the Catalog, GeometryStore and serving export are derivative databases offered under the ODbL.

name: Geofabrik
reason: Mirror the OSM snapshots are downloaded from (dayhike fetch); the data is OpenStreetMap's. It serves data extracts, not raster tiles.

name: FABDEM V1-2
reason: Default DEM (ADR-0008): every elevation-derived value is adapted material, non-commercial only.

name: Copernicus DEM GLO-30
reason: Alternative DEM (ADR-0030), free for commercial use with its notice; an export sampled from it carries that notice in place of FABDEM's.

name: ESA WorldCover 2021
reason: Land-cover shares and the waterside share per hike.

name: CHELSA V2.1
reason: Per-hike monthly climate averages (ADR-0015).

name: GeoNames
reason: Towns and villages of the place search, in places.sqlite of the serving export (ADR-0029).

name: Natural Earth
reason: Country shapes of the coverage map.

name: OpenStreetMap tile server
reason: The page's base map. Policy: no bulk download or prefetch, visible attribution, a real User-Agent, best-effort with no SLA; a busier site needs its own tiles.

name: Nominatim
reason: Place search fallback when an export has no places.sqlite; at most one request per second, no autocomplete.

name: Protomaps Basemap
reason: Self-hosted PMTiles base map for when traffic outgrows the OSM tile policy: "distributed as an Open Database License Produced Work (OpenStreetMap attribution required)"; hotlinking the downloads is discouraged, so it needs its own hosting.

name: Sport Ireland Trail Routes
reason: 1,029 walking trails, 72 % of their starts without a Trailhead within 1 km; credit "Sport Ireland".

name: Lipas
reason: About 1,725 active hiking routes and nature trails (types 4405/4404); production terms are CC BY 4.0 (the dev API spec says CC BY-SA); credit "Jyväskylän yliopisto, Lipas Liikuntapaikat.fi".

name: Turrutebasen (Kartverket)
reason: National foot, ski and bike route register; Kartverket gave OSM explicit permission (renewed 2021, covering CC BY 4.0 and ODbL): https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/No:Kartverket_import

name: Randonnées du Parc national des Écrins
reason: 737 curated day hikes in schema_randonnee GeoJSON; licence is Licence Ouverte 2.0 (data.gouv.fr "lov2"), not ODbL. Other schema_randonnee datasets get a row each.

name: Open Data Hub South Tyrol, Tourism API
reason: CC0 records only: the licence is per record (LicenseInfo.License, ClosedData) and images carry their own licence.

name: Wikidata
reason: Sitelinks of the trail, peak or hut as a popularity signal; licence fits, usefulness is measured in #156.

name: Wikimedia pageviews
reason: Monthly article views; licence fits (a User-Agent header is required), usefulness is measured in #156.

name: Wikimedia Commons structured data
licence: CC0 1.0 (structured data; each file keeps its own licence)
reason: Distinct photographers of geotagged photos near a line; the structured data is CC0, the photos are not. Usefulness is measured in #156.

name: Strava Global Heatmap
reason: Permission is "for tracing into OSM only"; any other use needs a Strava Metro agreement.

name: OpenStreetMap public GPS traces
licence: No public reuse licence found (OSM Contributor Terms grant rights to the OSMF)
reason: No licence lets a third party reuse raw traces, and identifiable traces are linked to the uploader's account, so they are personal data.

name: Flickr
licence: Flickr API terms (each photo its own licence)
reason: API terms forbid caching or storing photos "other than for reasonable periods in order to provide the service you are providing to Flickr users".

name: Mapillary
reason: Rejected as a popularity signal (#156); the imagery is CC BY-SA 4.0 user content, share-alike, so it can only be shown with credit, never mixed into the ODbL database.

name: Waymarked Trails
licence: Overlay CC BY-SA 3.0 DE; GPX ODbL
reason: Its data is OpenStreetMap, which we already read; "Mass download is not allowed" for its GPX tracks.

name: Wikiloc
reason: Terms prohibit robots or any tool "to access, copy or control any part of the Website". The page blocked our automated fetch (HTTP 403); clause from a search snippet, re-read by hand before relying on the wording.

name: AllTrails
reason: Terms forbid automated agents "to strip, scrape, or mine data from" the Products.

name: Komoot
reason: "The user may not use content and features in any other way except those described" in the terms.

name: Outdooractive API
reason: Paid; "the API user is prohibited from distributing or making accessible the content obtained via the APIs".

name: Strava
reason: "Automated access to or collection of data from the Services ... is prohibited."

name: Bergfex
reason: Content "may not be copied or used, even in part, without authorisation".

name: hikr
reason: Community reports with no open licence found, so all rights reserved; the site blocked our automated fetch (HTTP 403), re-check by hand if it matters.

name: Visorando
reason: "La licence confère à l'utilisateur un droit d'usage privé, non collectif et non exclusif".

name: Walkhighlands
reason: Routes and GPX are "free for your own use" but "cannot be re-published or re-sold". The page blocked our automated fetch (HTTP 403); clause from a search snippet.

name: UT.no
licence: CC BY-NC 4.0 (user content); rest all rights reserved
reason: Non-commercial licence. The page blocked our automated fetch (HTTP 403); licence from a search snippet. Norway's open route data is Turrutebasen instead.

name: Wikivoyage
reason: Share-alike prose: it cannot sit beside the ODbL database without relicensing it.

name: Senderos FEDME (IGN/CNIG)
reason: Lines: yes (one GPX/KML/SHP file per stage). Features: 6,923 files listed by CNIG (per stage or per stage and format not yet confirmed). CNIG: "Senderos FEDME ... CC-BY 4.0 FEDME", credit "FEDME"; GR and PR series seen, SL not confirmed. GR/PR/SL are FEDME trademarks: route refs as facts only, no logos.

name: Naturvårdsverket Leder och friluftsanordningar
coverage: Sweden (protected areas and state mountain trails)
reason: Lines: yes (MultiCurve). Features: 12,054 trail sections (LED) and 2,004 state trail sections (STATLIG_LED), WFS hits count; sections need joining per Led_ID, winter and paddling routes filtered out. Section 2.1: "Data publiceras enligt licenstypen CC0"; no separate terms for county or municipality records found.

name: Forestry England Recreation Routes
reason: Lines: yes (polyline). Features: 2,160, 562 of them Walking (ArcGIS count). The publisher's item says "Use of this data is subject to the Open Government Licence" and maps must credit "Contains, or is based on, information supplied by the Forestry Commission. © Crown copyright and database right Ordnance Survey" with its licence number: the lines may be OS-derived, so never contribute them to OSM.

name: Forestry and Land Scotland Recreation Routes
reason: Lines: yes (polyline). Features: 1,599 (ArcGIS count), 969 Forest Trail. OGL v3 on the publisher's item, but "this feature service will be retired when the Open Data site for FLS is released" and the data was last edited in 2021; find the successor site, and whether an OS credit is needed.

name: DZT Knowledge Graph (Open Data Germany)
licence: Per record (CC0, CC BY 4.0, CC BY-SA, CC BY-NC or unknown)
reason: Lines: not verified (the Trail schema allows a line but does not require one). Features: unknown, the API needs a key. Each provider picks a licence per record: only CC0 and CC BY records are usable, CC BY-SA, NC and "unknown" are not.

name: Premiumwanderwege im Saarland
reason: Lines: yes (MultiCurve). Features: 94 named day loops with distance, duration and difficulty (WFS hits count). Geoportal layer page: "Lizenz: Namensnennung 4.0 International — Quellenvermerk: © GDI-SL (Jahr)". The GDK record would not load; the licence is from the publisher's geoportal.
